variants.name: add-refuses-at-six
variants.why: Add shape stays enabled; with six objects on the poster pressing it adds nothing and a visible message says the maximum is six.

variants.name: visibility-pressed-toggle
variants.why: Each layer has one toggle button that keeps the name Hide and reports aria-pressed while its object is hidden; pressing it again shows the object.

variants.name: review-back-to-front
variants.why: The Review layers dialog lists the exact order from the back of the poster to the front and says so; the Layers list runs front to back.

variants.name: review-visibility-on-off
variants.why: The Review layers dialog reports visibility as "visibility on" and "visibility off"; the brief fixes no wording.
